#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
const int MAXK = 21;
const int MAXN = (1 << MAXK) + 1;

namespace {
    double wR[MAXN], wI[MAXN], rR[MAXN], rI[MAXN], aR[MAXN], aI[MAXN];
    int dp[MAXN];
    int n, k, lastk = -1;
}

namespace FFT {
    void fft(bool inv) {
        if (lastk != k) {
            lastk = k;
            dp[0] = 0;
            for (int i = 1, g = -1; i < n; i++) {
                if ((i & (i - 1)) == 0) g++;
                dp[i] = dp[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (k - 1 - g));
            }
            wR[1] = 1;
            wI[1] = 0;
            for (int t = 0; t < k - 1; t++) {
                double a = M_PI / n * (1 << (k - 1 - t));
                double curR = cos(a), curI = sin(a);
                int p2 = (1 << t), p3 = p2 * 2;
                for (int j = p2, kk = j * 2; j < p3; j++, kk += 2) {
                    wR[kk] = wR[j];
                    wI[kk] = wI[j];
                    wR[kk + 1] = wR[j] * curR - wI[j] * curI;
                    wI[kk + 1] = wR[j] * curI + wI[j] * curR;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int d = dp[i];
            if (i < d) {
                swap(aR[i], aR[d]);
                swap(aI[i], aI[d]);
            }
        }
        if (inv) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) aI[i] = -aI[i];
        for (int len = 1; len < n; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                int wit = len;
                for (int it = 0, j = i + len; it < len; it++, i++, j++) {
                    double tmpR = aR[j] * wR[wit] - aI[j] * wI[wit];
                    double tmpI = aR[j] * wI[wit] + aI[j] * wR[wit];
                    wit++;
                    aR[j] = aR[i] - tmpR;
                    aI[j] = aI[i] - tmpI;
                    aR[i] += tmpR;
                    aI[i] += tmpI;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    vector<long long> multiply(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b) {
        int na = a.size(), nb = b.size();
        for (k = 0, n = 1; n < na + nb - 1; n <<= 1, k++) {}
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            aR[i] = i < na ? a[i] : 0;
            aI[i] = i < nb ? b[i] : 0;
        }
        fft(false);
        aR[n] = aR[0];
        aI[n] = aI[0];
        double q = -1.0 / n / 4.0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - i; ++i) {
            double tmpR = aR[i] * aR[i] - aI[i] * aI[i];
            double tmpI = aR[i] * aI[i] * 2;
            tmpR -= aR[n - i] * aR[n - i] - aI[n - i] * aI[n - i];
            tmpI -= aR[n - i] * aI[n - i] * -2;
            aR[i] = -tmpI * q;
            aI[i] = tmpR * q;
            aR[n - i] = aR[i];
            aI[n - i] = -aI[i];
        }
        fft(true);
        vector<long long> ans(na + nb - 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)ans.size(); i++) {
            ans[i] = (long long)round(aR[i]) % MOD;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    vector<long long> multiplyPrecise(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b) {
        long long k = (long long)sqrt(MOD);
        vector<long long> a1(a.size()), a2(a.size());
        vector<long long> b1(b.size()), b2(b.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
            a1[i] = a[i] % k;
            a2[i] = a[i] / k;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
            b1[i] = b[i] % k;
            b2[i] = b[i] / k;
        }
        vector<long long> r11 = multiply(a1, b1);
        vector<long long> r12 = multiply(a1, b2);
        vector<long long> r21 = multiply(a2, b1);
        vector<long long> r22 = multiply(a2, b2);
        vector<long long> res(r11.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)res.size(); i++) {
            res[i] = (k * k % MOD * r22[i] % MOD + k * ((r12[i] + r21[i]) % MOD) % MOD + r11[i]) % MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }

    // 2D FFT helpers (not used in main)
    void fft2(vector<vector<double>>& xr, vector<vector<double>>& xi, bool inv) {
        int n = xr[0].size();
        int k = __builtin_ctz(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)xr.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) { aR[j] = xr[i][j]; aI[j] = xi[i][j]; }
            fft(inv);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) { xr[i][j] = aR[j] / (inv ? n : 1); xi[i][j] = aI[j] / (inv ? -n : 1); }
        }
        n = xr.size();
        k = __builtin_ctz(n);
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)xr[0].size(); j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { aR[i] = xr[i][j]; aI[i] = xi[i][j]; }
            fft(inv);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { xr[i][j] = aR[i] / (inv ? n : 1); xi[i][j] = aI[i] / (inv ? -n : 1); }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<long long>> multiply2(const vector<vector<long long>>& a, const vector<vector<long long>>& b) {
        int n1, n2;
        for (n1 = 1; n1 < (int)a.size() + (int)b.size() - 1; n1 <<= 1) {}
        for (n2 = 1; n2 < (int)a[0].size() + (int)b[0].size() - 1; n2 <<= 1) {}
        vector<vector<double>> ar(n1, vector<double>(n2, 0)), ai(n1, vector<double>(n2, 0));
        vector<vector<double>> br(n1, vector<double>(n2, 0)), bi(n1, vector<double>(n2, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < (int)a[i].size(); j++) ar[i][j] = a[i][j];
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < (int)b[i].size(); j++) br[i][j] = b[i][j];
        fft2(ar, ai, false);
        fft2(br, bi, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < n1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n2; j++) {
                double r1 = ar[i][j], r2 = br[i][j];
                double i1 = ai[i][j], i2 = bi[i][j];
                double real = r1 * r2 - i1 * i2;
                ai[i][j] = i1 * r2 + i2 * r1;
                ar[i][j] = real;
            }
        }
        fft2(ar, ai, true);
        vector<vector<long long>> result((int)a.size() + (int)b.size() - 1, vector<long long>((int)a[0].size() + (int)b[0].size() - 1));
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)result.size(); i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < (int)result[0].size(); j++) result[i][j] = (long long)round(ar[i][j]) % MOD;
        return result;
    }

    vector<long long> multiplyOr(vector<long long> eq1, vector<long long> eq2) {
        int n = max(eq1.size(), eq2.size());
        if ((n & (n - 1)) != 0)
            n = 1 << (__builtin_ctz(0) + 1);
        eq1 = fftOr(eq1, n, false);
        eq2 = fftOr(eq2, n, false);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < eq1.size(); i++) eq1[i] *= eq2[i];
        eq1 = fftOr(eq1, n, true);
        return eq1;
    }

    vector<long long> fftOr(vector<long long> arr, int n, bool invert) {
        vector<long long> ans = arr;
        ans.resize(n);
        for (int b = 1; b < n; b <<= 1)
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((i & b) != 0) continue;
                ans[i + b] += invert ? -ans[i] : ans[i];
            }
        return ans;
    }

    vector<long long> fftXor(vector<long long> arr, int n, bool invert) {
        vector<long long> ans = arr;
        ans.resize(n);
        for (int b = 1; b < n; b <<= 1)
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((i & b) != 0) continue;
                long long u = ans[i], v = ans[i + b];
                ans[i] = u + v;
                ans[i + b] = u - v;
            }
        if (invert) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans[i] /= n;
        return ans;
    }
} // namespace FFT

vector<long long> expo(const vector<long long>& orig, long long pow) {
    if (pow == 1) return orig;
    if (pow & 1) return FFT::multiplyPrecise(orig, expo(orig, pow - 1));
    vector<long long> tmp = expo(orig, pow >> 1);
    return FFT::multiplyPrecise(tmp, tmp);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<long long> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int d;
        cin >> d;
        base[d] = 1;
    }
    vector<long long> res = expo(base, n >> 1);
    long long tot = 0;
    for (long long e : res) {
        tot = (tot + (e * e) % MOD) % MOD;
    }
    cout << tot << endl;
    return 0;
}
